fo.title: Failover
fo.hint: A linked server kept in sync with this one: change something on either and the other follows.
fo.needsOnline: The server has to be online to ask it
fo.sheetIntro: This server and {name} will keep each other in sync, both ways, within seconds of every change. This is what syncs:
fo.notYet: Each server keeps its own network addresses, disks, data folder, certificates and activity history. Files sync too: choose the folders on the Failover page once it's on.
fo.space: The settings take about {size} on the other server.
fo.primaryTitle: Which server's settings win the first sync?
fo.primarySelfHint: {name}'s accounts and settings are replaced by this server's.
fo.primaryPeerHint: This server's accounts and settings are replaced by {name}'s.
fo.bothAgree: An administrator on {name} has to accept before anything syncs.
fo.catHint.accounts: users, groups, passwords, two-step sign-in, preferences
fo.catHint.backups: backup places, plans and cloud imports
fo.catHint.settings: server settings, scripts, AI providers, remote connections
fo.primaryIsSelf: This server was primary for the first sync
fo.primaryIsPeer: {name} was primary for the first sync
fo.hAsked: Waiting for an administrator on {name} to accept.
fo.hAsking: {name} asks this server to be its failover pair.
fo.hStartingPrimary: {name} is taking this server's accounts and settings.
fo.hStarting: This server is taking {name}'s accounts and settings.
fo.hPaused: Sync is paused on this server. Changes wait until you resume.
fo.hFailing: The last few syncs didn't work. Changes wait until the servers reach each other again.
fo.hBehind: No sync for over a minute. It keeps trying.
fo.hOk: Both servers have the same accounts and settings.
fo.acceptMsgSelf: {name} will take this server's accounts and settings, and from then on both stay in sync.
fo.acceptMsgPeer: This server's accounts and settings will be replaced by {name}'s, and from then on both stay in sync. Accounts only on this server are removed.
fo.declineMsg: {name} will be told. It can ask again later.
fo.offMsg: The two servers stop syncing. Each keeps what it has now. {name} is told and stops too.
fo.conflictsHint: These were changed here and on {name} before they synced. The newest change is in use; choose which one stays.
fo.filesHint: Choose the folders that sync. Files sync as they change, with checksums; deleted files go to the other server's recycle bin, and a file changed on both servers keeps both versions. App data of a running app waits until the app stops.
fo.outsideWindow: Files only sync between {from} and {to}; settings sync any time.
fo.kind.appdata: Apps' data, sent while each app is stopped
fo.kind.config: Container stacks and Shield DNS settings, always synced
fo.filesSpace: The other server needs about {size} free for these folders.
fo.windowHint: Leave the times empty to sync files at any time. Sync now ignores the schedule.
fo.filesSaved: File sync updated on both servers
